address: The Cumberland Hotel, Great Cumberland Place, Marble Arch, London,W1H 7DL
bio: The classic Afternoon Tea has been turned on it's head as it features bold international flavours and Americana inspired cuisine.  Bottomless options includes sparkling wine, house wines, draft beers, and soft drinks. While the tower of mouth-watering bites will take centre stage.  Why not upgrade to bottomless cocktails if your really want to 'Spill the tea...!' Located within The Cumberland Hotel on the corner of Oxford Street and Park Lane, SOUND brings you live music 7 days a week.
